articles.title: Odelein dies at 58, was first Blue Jackets captain
Canadiens, Banque Nationale partner on premium space at Bell Centre
Lines and defense pairings at practice – Oct. 5

away.summary: The Carolina Hurricanes are coming off a 3-2 overtime win over the Flyers, with Pyotr Kochetkov starting in net. They have struggled with scoring but have been effective on the power play. Seth Jarvis is returning to practice after shoulder surgery.

home.summary: The Montreal Canadiens are coming off a 6-5 overtime loss to the Penguins but have shown resilience with a comeback effort. Jakub Dobes is confirmed to start in net, and captain Nick Suzuki is leading the team's scoring efforts.
